description: This file generates a JSON representation of API documentation by parsing source files and serializing the documentation objects, including classes, members, and types.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the documentation object into an array of class representations.

methods.name: serializeClass
methods.description: Serializes a class object into a structured JSON format, including its members and types.

methods.name: serializeMember
methods.description: Serializes a class member, including its arguments and type.

methods.name: serializeProperty
methods.description: Serializes a property or argument, including its type.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Removes internal or unnecessary properties from objects to clean up the serialization output.

methods.name: serializeType
methods.description: Serializes a type object, including properties, union types, templates, arguments, and return types.
